import React from 'react'
import {Container, Row, Col} from 'react-bootstrap'
import {Link} from 'react-router-dom'
 
function Train({props}) {
  return (
    <Link to={`/train/details/${props.train_number}`} style={{textDecoration: 'none', color: 'white'}}>
      <Container fluid>
        <Row style={{ borderBottom: '2px solid black', padding: '3px'}}>
            <Col md={1}>
              Check Running status
            </Col>
            <Col md={1}>
                Train no. : {props.train_number}
            </Col>
            <Col md={2}>
                Train name : {props.train_name}
            </Col>
            <Col md={2}>
                Date : {props.train_date}
            </Col>
            <Col md={2}>
                arrival time : {props.from_sta}
            </Col>            
            <Col md={2}>
                Reach destination at : {props.to_sta}
            </Col>
            <Col md={2}>
                last station : {props.to_station_name}
            </Col>
        </Row>
      </Container>
    </Link>
  )
}

export default Train
